# SIRUI Official Store

> > Official e-commerce store for SIRUI photography and videography equipment, specializing in anamorphic lenses, carbon fiber tripods, and professional camera support systems.

SIRUI offers a comprehensive range of professional imaging equipment including the AURORA autofocus series, anamorphic cinema lenses (Venus, Saturn, Sniper), carbon fiber tripods (Traveler X series), monopods, fluid heads, and lighting solutions. Products support multiple camera mounts (E, RF, Z, X) for both APS-C and full-frame formats.

## Key Topics

- Anamorphic lenses
- SIRUI AURORA series
- Traveler X carbon fiber tripods
- Cine lenses
- APS-C format lenses
- Full-frame autofocus lenses
- E mount / RF mount / Z mount compatibility
- Carbon fiber monopods
- Fluid heads for video
- Portrait photography lenses (75mm, 85mm)
- 50mm cinema lenses
- Travel tripods
- Light stands and C-stands
- Macro photography equipment
- Spotting scopes and observation gear
